scope: local synthetic backup and restore admission
controls: Collaborative documents use their persisted teamId/documentId composite identity rather than a nonexistent generic id field.
Document identity is non-empty and unique within its team.
Version is positive, content is present, and updatedAt is canonical UTC ISO-8601 with milliseconds.
updatedBy references a current member of the owning team.
Tenant and team ownership remain consistent.
limitations: This does not exercise live collaborative transport, identity-provider recovery, authenticated LibTV team behavior, deployment, or external backup retention.
